verdict.rationale: Zero ships an MCP.md file describing its MCP server tools (email search, compose, labels, etc.), which is agent-facing documentation an AI agent could be pointed at to learn available actions, but there's no dedicated llms.txt file or explicit agent-context doc standard, and no evidence of independent agent consumption of it. missing for 10: an actual llms.txt file, evidence of an agent successfully using MCP.md as context, and any documentation framed specifically for LLM consumption rather than as a developer-facing MCP spec.
